content.what_it_is: Commented interactive MATLAB movie generator with user-configurable output/depth directories, figure visibility, and time-title toggle (L8-L23). It reads inclusive frame bounds, sizes coordinates from depth.txt, opens a 10 fps AVI writer, optionally hides the figure, then loads, threshold-masks, renders, captures, and writes each eta frame (L25-L98).
entities: eta directory fdir defined at L9
depth directory fdep defined from fdir at L12
visibility toggle do_not_show_figure defined at L16
time-title toggle show_time defined at L19
interactive frame bounds ns and ne defined at L26-L27
unused variable mask loaded from eta_00001 at L30
depth array dep1 loaded at L31
grid dimensions n and m defined at L34
coordinate origins x0/y0 and spacings dx/dy defined at L37-L40
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L41-L42
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L57-L58
loop index num defined at L61
formatted suffix fnum defined at L65
eta loaded at L68 and modified at L71
formatted time string time defined at L85
captured frame currframe defined at L92

equations.ref: replace eta values above 10 with NaN

unresolved: Visibility/capture interface risk across L16, L52-L54, and L92: enabling the advertised no-display mode hides the figure but frames are still acquired with getframe, which on MATLAB configurations requiring a visible rendered figure can error or produce unusable frames; no alternate off-screen renderer is provided.
mask loaded from eta_00001 at L30 is never used and is not a mask; invalid regions are inferred solely by eta>10 at L71, potentially discarding legitimate values above that threshold.
Cross-file shape assumption across L31-L42 and L68-L77: coordinates come from depth.txt, but eta dimensions are not checked before plotting.

Interactive ns/ne at L26-L27 are not validated as ordered integers. A reversed range creates an empty video, while a load/render error after opening at L48 bypasses close at L98 and can leave the output incomplete.
MATLAB pcolor at L77 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present.
